findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in pandas
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization operations (pickle, yaml, marshal, shelve) that could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE) in pandas
 * @description XML parsing with external entities enabled can lead to XXE attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // lxml parsing with dangerous settings
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember(["etree", "ElementTree"]).getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall() or
    // xml.etree parsing
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember(["etree", "ElementTree"]).getMember(["parse", "fromstring"]).getACall() or
    // xml.sax parsing
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall() or
    // xml.dom parsing
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "XML parsing operation that could be vulnerable to XXE attacks if external entities are not disabled."
findings.hypothesis: XML parsing operations that could be vulnerable to XXE attacks if external entities are not properly disabled
